name: Galaxy Orion

seo.title: Galaxy Orion Yacht Galapagos: Cruises | James Wild & Co
seo.description: Galaxy Orion, a renovated 14-guest Galapagos expedition yacht with 8 cabins. 3, 4 and 7-night routes, including a full week to Genovesa and the west.

tagline: A renovated expedition yacht for just 14 guests.
answer: Galaxy Orion is a renovated expedition yacht that Galaxy Cruises created for an exclusive group of 14 guests, in 8 cabins, with 9 crew, a cruise director and one bilingual naturalist guide. She sails 3, 4 and 7-night routes between Baltra and San Cristobal, from US$1,800 per person in 2026, and is available for private charter.
facts: 8; most on the Main and Upper decks have panoramic windows
Naturalist cruise (Galaxy's label; no class grade on the page)
Southern 3 nights, Eastern 4 nights, Central Northern 7 nights, Southeastern 7 nights
Over 6 on shared departures; any age on charter (Galaxy terms)
overview: Galaxy Orion is a renovated motor yacht that Galaxy Cruises says was created for an exclusive group of guests. She takes 14 guests in eight cabins with air conditioning, hair dryers and eco-friendly toiletries; most cabins on the Main and Upper decks have panoramic windows.
There is a dining room with local-ingredient cooking, social areas and outdoor decks, with kayaks, snorkel gear and wetsuits on board.

The 7-night Central Northern Route loops from Baltra through southern and western Isabela, Fernandina, Santiago and Genovesa. The 3-night Southern Route runs San Cristobal to Baltra via Espanola and Floreana; the 4-night Eastern Route runs Baltra to San Cristobal via Bartolome, South Plaza and Santa Fe; the two join into a 7-night Southeastern loop.
why: Fourteen guests on a yacht built for 16-guest routes, and Galaxy says she suits large families and exclusive groups on charter.
The Central Northern week covers both the west and Genovesa in seven nights, from US$4,200 per person in 2026.

Occupancy basis not stated. Dated departures were not captured: Galaxy's booking feed loads in the browser and could not be read on 2 Nov 2026. Galaxy publishes 2026 itinerary prices only on the yacht page; 2027 prices are not published there.
inclusions: Airport assistance on the cruise start date
Cruise director and personalised crew service
All meals from lunch on day one to breakfast on the last day
A snack after each activity (except the last day) and a welcome cocktail
Unlimited purified water, coffee and tea
All visits, excursions and activities in the itinerary
Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins) and wetsuits
Transport and refuelling in the Galapagos Marine Reserve
exclusions: International flights to and from Ecuador
Flights between Quito or Guayaquil and the Galapagos
Galapagos National Park entrance fee, US$200 per person
Transit Control Card, US$20 per person
Travel insurance (Galaxy calls it highly recommended)
children: Galaxy Cruises' terms accept children over 6 on shared departures and children of any age on a full charter; under-12s share a cabin with an adult or sleep in a cabin next to their parents. The booking form prices children aged 6 to 11 separately. Galaxy says Orion suits large families or exclusive groups on private charter.
